name: Shrine of Baba Farid
scope: The standing chamber and cusped dome over Baba Farid’s tomb in Pakpattan, with the east Nuri Darwaza and south Bahishti Darwaza.
era: Standing chamber documented by the architectural survey and current archaeology inventory.

review.notes: Screened the published Qualla images first. The reported 1928 photograph has an unverified original publication and an unidentified creator. The accompanying mosque photos require attribution. The tomb uses the independent monument locator, the original written architectural survey and original ground elevation.
